In film, Quinn gained further recognition for starring in the science fiction horror film ''[[A Quiet Place: Day One]]'' (2024) as well as for portraying emperor [[Geta (emperor)|Geta]] in the historical action film ''[[Gladiator II]]'' (2024) and [[Characters of the Marvel Cinematic Universe: M–Z#Johnny Storm / Human Torch|Johnny Storm / Human Torch]] in the [[Marvel Cinematic Universe]] film ''[[The Fantastic Four: First Steps]]'' (2025). == Early life and education ==
== Early life and education ==
Quinn was born on 26 January 1994<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.gq-magazine.co.uk/article/joseph-quinn-interview-2024 |title=Joseph Quinn's strange new world |website=[[GQ]] |first=Colin |last=Groundwater |date=12 June 2024 |accessdate=12 June 2024}}</ref><ref name=":0" /> and brought up in [[South London]].<ref name="2018 sot">{{Cite web |date=4 October 2018 |title=Stars of Tomorrow 2018: Joseph Quinn (actor) |url=https://www.screendaily.com/features/stars-of-tomorrow-2018-joseph-quinn-actor/5133190.article |access-date=13 June 2022 |website=Screen Daily |language=en |archive-date=17 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190817223659/https://www.screendaily.com/features/stars-of-tomorrow-2018-joseph-quinn-actor/5133190.article |url-status=live}}</ref> His father, Anthony, works as head of screen and audio performance at the [[London Academy of Music and Dramatic Art]] (LAMDA).<ref>{{Cite web |last=Parajuli |first=Rovik |date=2024-05-14 |title=The Private Life Of Joseph Quinn And His Talented Family |url=https://amy-movie.com/blog/the-private-life-of-joseph-quinn-and-his-talented-family/ |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=amy-movie.com |language=en-US}}</ref> Through his parents, Quinn holds both British and Irish citizenship.<ref name="Porzio">{{Cite web |last=Porzio |first=Stephen |date=2025-07-22 |title=Fantastic Four star on being an Irish citizen and playing one of The Beatles |url=https://www.joe.ie/movies-tv/joseph-quinn-irish-the-fantastic-four-first-steps-interview-release-date |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250722161106/https://www.joe.ie/movies-tv/joseph-quinn-irish-the-fantastic-four-first-steps-interview-release-date-849620 |archive-date=2025-07-22 |access-date=2026-06-16 |website=Joe.ie |language=en}}</ref>
Quinn was born on 26 January 1994<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.gq-magazine.co.uk/article/joseph-quinn-interview-2024 |title=Joseph Quinn's strange new world |website=[[GQ]] |first=Colin |last=Groundwater |date=12 June 2024 |accessdate=12 June 2024}}</ref><ref name=":0" /> and brought up in [[South London]].<ref name="2018 sot">{{Cite web |date=4 October 2018 |title=Stars of Tomorrow 2018: Joseph Quinn (actor) |url=https://www.screendaily.com/features/stars-of-tomorrow-2018-joseph-quinn-actor/5133190.article |access-date=13 June 2022 |website=Screen Daily |language=en |archive-date=17 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190817223659/https://www.screendaily.com/features/stars-of-tomorrow-2018-joseph-quinn-actor/5133190.article |url-status=live}}</ref> His father, Anthony, works as head of screen and audio performance at the [[London Academy of Music and Dramatic Art]] (LAMDA).<ref>{{Cite web |last=Parajuli |first=Rovik |date=2024-05-14 |title=The Private Life Of Joseph Quinn And His Talented Family |url=https://amy-movie.com/blog/the-private-life-of-joseph-quinn-and-his-talented-family/ |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=amy-movie.com |language=en-US}}</ref> Through his parents, Quinn holds both British and Irish citizenship.<ref name="Porzio">{{Cite web |last=Porzio |first=Stephen |date=2025-07-22 |title=Fantastic Four star on being an Irish citizen and playing one of The Beatles |url=https://www.joe.ie/movies-tv/joseph-quinn-irish-the-fantastic-four-first-steps-interview-release-date |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250722161106/https://www.joe.ie/movies-tv/joseph-quinn-irish-the-fantastic-four-first-steps-interview-release-date-849620 |archive-date=2025-07-22 |access-date=2026-06-16 |website=Joe.ie |language=en}}</ref>

He attended [[Emanuel School|Emanuel]], a [[Private schools in the United Kingdom|private school]], from 2007 to 2012.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Joe Quinn |url=https://www.emanuel.org.uk/casestudy/joe-quinn/ |access-date=13 June 2022 |website=Emanuel |language=en-GB |archive-date=18 July 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220718072614/https://www.emanuel.org.uk/casestudy/joe-quinn/ |url-status=live}}</ref> He subsequently went to [[drama school]] at LAMDA, graduating in 2015.<ref name=":0">{{Cite magazine |date=27 May 2022 |title=Stranger Things: Meet Joe Quinn, the Englishman Behind Eddie Munson |url=https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2022/05/stranger-things-joe-quinn-eddie-interview |access-date=13 June 2022 |magazine=Vanity Fair |first=Johana |last=Desta |language=en-US |archive-date=27 May 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220527165526/https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2022/05/stranger-things-joe-quinn-eddie-interview |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Acting Alumni {{!}} London academy of music & dramatic art |url=https://www.lamda.ac.uk/students-alumni/alumni |access-date=13 June 2022 |website=lamda.ac.uk |language=en |archive-date=19 August 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200819065018/https://www.lamda.ac.uk/students-alumni/alumni |url-status=live}}</ref>
He attended [[Emanuel School|Emanuel]], a [[Private schools in the United Kingdom|private school]], from 2007 to 2012.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Joe Quinn |url=https://www.emanuel.org.uk/casestudy/joe-quinn/ |access-date=13 June 2022 |website=Emanuel |language=en-GB |archive-date=18 July 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220718072614/https://www.emanuel.org.uk/casestudy/joe-quinn/ |url-status=live}}</ref> He subsequently went to [[drama school]] at LAMDA, graduating in 2015.<ref name=":0">{{Cite magazine |date=27 May 2022 |title=Stranger Things: Meet Joe Quinn, the Englishman Behind Eddie Munson |url=https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2022/05/stranger-things-joe-quinn-eddie-interview |access-date=13 June 2022 |magazine=Vanity Fair |first=Johana |last=Desta |language=en-US |archive-date=27 May 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220527165526/https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2022/05/stranger-things-joe-quinn-eddie-interview |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Acting Alumni {{!}} London academy of music & dramatic art |url=https://www.lamda.ac.uk/students-alumni/alumni |access-date=13 June 2022 |website=lamda.ac.uk |language=en |archive-date=19 August 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200819065018/https://www.lamda.ac.uk/students-alumni/alumni |url-status=live}}</ref>

items.title: [mjulius] On romantic fantasy and OSR D&D
items.content_html: Consider a story like Ghibli's Spirited Away. Chihiro is thrown into a supernatural world dominated by cruelty and injustice, but she doesn't defeat it by hoarding magical power-ups until she's strong enough to punch Yubaba in the face. She wins because she's brave and clever and empathic enough to make friends and build alliances, and at the end of the day her courage and emotional intelligence prove to be more than a match for Yubaba's evil sorcery.
